verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK, so CPU+GPU offload for oversized models is a fair question. The evidence does not document layer splitting or partial GPU offload. The only answer to 'models too large' is routing to hosted cloud hardware (docs-13), which is a different capability. Generic 'accelerated by whatever silicon' claims and NPU support do not describe offloading a model across CPU and GPU memory.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
